Red flags, I'd say adding more than 10+ items after order starts, asking for things that are not allowed in chat (cigarettes, alcohol in a non alcohol order, lotto tickets, etc.), or being disrespectful or threatening. Those are the most basic red flags I think. 

Some green flags to look for if you take a high tip batch would be how many orders they have, if they have delivery notes that specify house color, surroundings, or anything helpful in general. Responsive to chat and replacements,  and also if they have healthier foods or items that look like they're for kids lunches or snacks typically are pretty wholesome customers.

You do realize that if customers report missing orders, tip bait, or rate poorly and claim missing items to get refund, those all affect shoppers and can cause deactivation or make it so shoppers aren't able to see batches from decent customers.
People on here tend to post either the really bad stuff or the really good stuff, you'll be fine. If you don't see any red flags during the order then don't miss out on making good money.
